title: DeepSafe-SciHazard: A Benchmark for Measuring Scientific Safety Risks with Decomposed Harm Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2607.18665v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support science, but they can also convert hazardous scientific knowledge into actionable misuse guidance. Existing benchmarks often rely on templated queries disconnected from real-world hazards, and employ LLM-as-a-Judge paradigms without domain grounding. To address this, we introduce SciHazard, a real-world-grounded benchmark for scientific risks and a dataset agnostic evaluation framework for measuring harmfulness. SciHazard contains 2400 hazardous questions and 600 oversafety questions across 12 disciplines, with both queries grounded in regulated entities and documented failure scenarios. To compute \textsc{DeHarm-Score} , we develop a decomposed evaluating procedure that combines query hazard severity, refusal behavior, and response-level risk. translated_title: DeepSafe-SciHazard：一个采用分解式危害评分衡量科学安全风险的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益支持科学研究，但它们也可能将危险的科学知识转化为可操作的错误使用指导。现有基准测试往往依赖于与真实世界危害脱节的模板化查询，并采用缺乏领域依据的LLM-as-a-Judge评估范式。为解决这些问题，我们提出了SciHazard，这是一个以真实世界为基础的科学风险基准测试，以及一个与数据集无关的危害性评估框架。SciHazard包含跨12个学科的2400个危险问题和600个过度安全问题，两类查询均基于受监管的实体和有记录的故障场景。为计算DeHarm-Score，我们开发了一种分解式评估程序，该程序结合了查询危害严重程度、拒绝行为和响应层面的风险。对于未被拒绝的响应，该方法进一步将响应层面的危害分解为可执行性，并通过动态清单进行量化……
tldr: 该论文提出了SciHazard，一个基于真实世界的科学安全风险基准，包含跨12个学科的2400个危险问题和600个过度安全问题，并开发了分解式的DeHarm-Score评估框架，通过综合查询危害严重程度、拒绝行为和响应层面风险来更准确地衡量大语言模型的科学安全风险。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SciHazard, a real-world-grounded benchmark for scientific safety risks containing 2,400 hazardous and 600 oversafety questions across 12 disciplines, along with a decomposed DeHarm-Score evaluation framework that combines query hazard severity, refusal behavior, and response-level risk to more accurately measure LLM scientific safety risks.
